pages.lesson:
LESSON: FRACTIONS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.3: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Fractions. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-028.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 28]]

From your pupil's book (page 28)

NUMBERS FRACTIONS Week 3 Lesson 3 A half as part of a whole

A whole Two equal 1 out of 2 parts parts is shaded. The shaded part is a half of a whole.

Work to do Make a half using circular paper cut-outs

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-092.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 92]]

From your pupil's book (page 92)

NUMBERS FRACTIONS Week 2 Lesson 4 A quarter

A whole Four equal 1 out of 4 parts parts is shaded. The shaded part is a quarter of a whole

Work to do Make a quarter using circular paper cut-out.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-155.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 155]]

From your pupil's book (page 155)

NUMBERS FRACTIONS Week 2 Lesson 4 A half and a quarter

Activity Which is bigger? Which is smaller?

A half is bigger than a quarter. A quarter is smaller than a half.

Work to do Using circular paper cut-outs, fold a half and a quarter. 1. Which is bigger? 2. Which is smaller?

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Fractions means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fractions.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Fractions
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
